name: Medical Cooling and Heating Electricity Concession Scheme (MCHECS)
summary: Yearly payment towards power costs for Queenslanders with a medical condition that needs air-conditioning or heating, who hold a concession card.
key: It currently provides $522.09 (including GST) per year to eligible applicants.
who: Have a qualifying condition such as multiple sclerosis, autonomic system dysfunction, or loss of skin integrity or sweating capacity
Hold a Pensioner Concession Card or a current Services Australia Health Care Card
Live at your principal place of residence with an air-conditioning or heating unit and pay the electricity bill
how: Complete the MCHECS application form and post it to the address on the form
Call 13 QGOV (13 74 68) if you can't use the PDF
catches: Paid quarterly into your bank account; eligibility reviewed every two years.
